issues.description: The UML and problem description specify the Farm.animals attribute as private (aggregation shown with '-' and instructions to provide a getter and setter), but the solution implementation declares the field as public (public List<Animal> animals). The template Farm.java also does not declare the attribute yet (expected to be implemented by students as a private field). This visibility inconsistency between the specification/UML and the solution could confuse students about the intended encapsulation and the need for getter/setter methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals field private to match the UML and problem instructions (private List<Animal> animals) and keep the getter and setter for access. Update the solution (and instruct students in the template) to declare the field as private and initialize it in the no-arg constructor using new ArrayList<>(), preserving the existing getAnimals() and setAnimals() methods.
